summary: West Elk Peak lookout, Shoshone County: tower erected 1935 at the peak's west end; gone by 1957, though sources differ between destroyed and removed.

facts.status_note: Sources differ on 1957: destroyed (firelookout.com, Idaho Fire Lookouts) or removed (Kresek, via Rex's page). No source describes the site now.

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts files the site as hike-in

events.note: Tower erected at the west end of the peak; patrol point East Elk
Firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts say destroyed
Rex's page, citing Kresek, says removed

evidence.supports: 1935 tower at west end, patrol on East Elk, destroyed 1957
evidence.quote: 1935: tower at west end. Patrol on East Elk. Destroyed 1957.

evidence.supports: about five miles north of Clarkia
1935 tower erected at west end of peak (Kresek)
evidence.quote: 1935: Tower erected at the west end of peak. (Kresek)

evidence.supports: list marks the tower as gone
evidence.quote: West Elk Peak Shoshone 47.08760 -116.27720 Tower Gone

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 1957 end is given as destroyed by firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts, and as removed by Kresek as reproduced on Rex's page. The story reports both and does not choose between them.

notes_for_editor: Brief said 1957 destroyed; sources agree on 1935 build and the 1957 end but disagree on destroyed vs removed, so both are recorded. Elevation 5054 ft and the 5 miles north of Clarkia location come from firelookout.com only. No staffing source (Idaho Fire Lookouts says no documented staffing), so staffing is omitted. Not conflated with 'Elk West' (separate St. Joe listing, 5299 ft, 1914 crow's nest, 1934 L-4 tower, gone) or with East Elk (a patrol point named in these pages; a different East Elk appears in the FFLA list in Clearwater County). The sources do not describe the site today beyond 'hike-in'. No new photos found.
